mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 71 degrees outside of Verona City Hall, with the moon currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects through September 20, and residents are also encouraged to check out our rain barrel rebate program which offers a 30 dollar credit per barrel for eligible stormwater utility properties.
We have plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and girls try hockey at the Verona Ice Arena happening today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
Regarding local safety, on Friday, August 15, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for an O W I after officers found her unresponsive behind the wheel of a moving vehicle.
Enjoy a scoop of Caramel Cashew at Culver's today, or visit Fireman's Park until 5 PM to grab a treat from the Kona Ice truck.
